- **What I ruled out:** adding √eps, 1/(eps+c), or log(eps) terms, sweeping the log-argument constant, and fitting free-exponent and exp(−c/T) temperature bases all stayed near 3e-5 or worse.

import numpy as np
def equation(eps, T, params):
    L = np.log(1+params[3]*eps)
    return (params[0]*np.exp(params[1]*T) + params[2]*L*np.exp(params[4]*T) + params[5]*eps
            + params[6]*np.exp(params[7]*T)*L*T + params[8]*eps*np.exp(params[9]*T))
